fields.summary_ko.0: AAPL represents 25% of BRK.A/BRK.B public stock portfolio as the largest holding, but despite November P/E of 36.8x (expensive), no additional sales occurred in Q3.
fields.summary_ko.1: Following Buffett's philosophy of holding exceptional businesses with superior management forever, the 11-year holding period since 2016 differentiates from short-term market behavior.
